issues.description: Method naming mismatch for the quantity accessor of StockIngredient: the template repository defines a method named retrieveQuantity() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) while other template code (Stock.java and Main.java) and the solution implementation expect and call getQuantity(). The problem statement also instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields" which implies the conventional getX naming. This inconsistency causes compilation errors in the template (calls to getQuantity() fail) and will confuse students about which getter to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template accessor retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), or add a new public getQuantity() method that returns the same value and delegates to retrieveQuantity(). Ensure all private fields have conventional getters as requested in the problem statement so calls to getQuantity() in Stock and Main compile and match the solution's API.
